The Chinese characters for Andrea

As a transliteration, Andrea is usually written 安德烈娅 (Ān dé liè yà). Origin and meaning

The name Andrea has Greek roots and means “strong, brave (feminine of Andrew)”.

About the name Andrea

The feminine of Andrew, common across many European languages.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Andrea carries the meaning “strong, brave (feminine of Andrew)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
